<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The Essence of Finality </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787526151978614824.png?v=1" alt="eof" title="eof" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/745279787471470713.png?v=1" alt="eofor" title="eofor" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is an amulet which combines the Amulet of Souls </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158359724056.png?v=1" alt="aos" title="aos" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Reaper Necklace </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159412494367.png?v=1" alt="Reaper" title="Reaper" kind="icon" /><nowiki> passives, as well as lets you store a special attack </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. This special attack can then be used through the Essence of Finality ability </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> in the Constitution </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1" alt="Constitution" title="Constitution" kind="icon" /><nowiki> ability book. These specs can be broken down into the following categories:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Costs 25% adrenaline</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For 15 seconds (25 ticks), Soul Split </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /><nowiki> no longer heals you, but deals 4x the amount of healing you would have gotten as damage against your target</nowiki></p>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Switching main hand weapons will end the effect, but switching off-hand weapons or amulets will not.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• ECB spec with 1h/DW/Chins</nowiki></p>

</nowiki>

</nowiki>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The damage range of the spec is based off of a couple factors, refer to the wiki for specifics: </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Seren_godbow#Special_attack <nowiki>https://runescape.wiki/w/Seren_godbow#Special_attack</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ What </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> lets you do that you normally cannot</nowiki></p>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Turns all single-target Ranged attacks into AoE attacks that hit up to 9 targets within a 3x3 area of the primary target for 10.8 seconds.</nowiki></p>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Allows usage of Decimation spec with higher tiered weapons and other special attacks, allowing for incredible AoE damage with SGB spec, Dark Bow spec, etc.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Allows usage of Decimation spec under the effect of Eldritch Crossbow </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1" alt="ecb" title="ecb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> spec</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>

</nowiki>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• When used, for 30 seconds all successful attacks on your opponent(s) adds a stack, which increases your damage by 1% per stack, capping at 20%</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The special attack will clear itself prematurely if: you switch weapons, you splash on any target, or if the special attack is used again within 30 seconds</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Functionally useless, as you can just use DBA </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1" alt="DBA" title="DBA" kind="icon" /><nowiki> spec and get a similar buff for a minute</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ What </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> lets you do that you normally cannot</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• A lasting damage amplifier that allows you to be mobile</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>

<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Allows you to change main hand and EoFs after casting the special attack, allowing you to use it while building before going into an encounter</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Scenarios it is used</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pushing High Enrage Telos </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513212949033123840.png?v=1" alt="Telos" title="Telos" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, Solo Beastmaster Durzag </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513212996948983809.png?v=1" alt="BeastmasterDurzag" title="BeastmasterDurzag" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Priority/usefulness (at said scenarios):</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>​</nowiki><code><nowiki>Low</nowiki></code><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="necromancy"><ins><nowiki>Necromancy </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="death-guard"><nowiki>Death Guard </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1" alt="deathguard90" title="deathguard90" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/780401412915855380.png?v=1" alt="eofblack" title="eofblack" kind="icon" /></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Special Attack: </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Death Grasp</nowiki></ins></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Costs 25% adrenaline</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Deals 405-495% ability damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It also deals an additional 40% necromancy damage per Necrosis </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1" alt="necrosis" title="necrosis" kind="icon" /><nowiki> stack, consuming all of them.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• At 12 Necrosis </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1" alt="necrosis" title="necrosis" kind="icon" /><nowiki> stacks, the special attack deals up to 885%–975% necromancy damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Has a cooldown of 30 seconds</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Stuns and binds the target for 4.8 seconds</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ What </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> lets you do that you normally cannot</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Easy use of the T90 special attack without carrying a switch</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Scenarios it is used</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Anywhere you use Necromancy</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Priority/usefulness (at said scenarios):</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>​</nowiki><code><nowiki>High</nowiki></code><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
